title: Determine the Minimum Sum of a k-avoiding Array
summary: Given integers n and k, find the smallest possible sum of a distinct positive integer array of length n where no two distinct elements sum to k.
statement: Given integers n and k, find the smallest possible sum of a distinct positive integer array of length n where no two distinct elements sum to k.
constraints: n and k are positive integers.
Choose n distinct positive integers with no two distinct selected values summing to k.
Return the minimum possible selected-value sum.
hints: Choosing a value only forbids its complementary value k-value.
Scan positive integers upward, select every unblocked candidate, and record its complement as blocked.
Continue until n values are chosen, then return their sum.
At each position the smallest feasible unused value minimizes the sorted selection prefix; replacing it with any larger value cannot improve later feasibility or reduce the total.
editorial: At each position the smallest feasible unused value minimizes the sorted selection prefix; replacing it with any larger value cannot improve later feasibility or reduce the total.

tests.explanation: The lexicographically smallest valid choice [1,2,4,5,6] sums to eighteen.
Values one and two do not sum to six and give the minimum sum three.
